csv_scope_of_work: Washington County Government wishes to hereby solicit the submittal of Request for Proposals (RFP) from qualified firms interested in and able to fulfill professional services for work at the Washington County Training and Learning Center for interior renovations for the Washington County Emergency Management Agency (EMA), Washington County 911, and for training space for the Washington County Sherriff s office.

title: A/E for Training & Learning Building Renovation
short_description: Renovation of a county training center for emergency management, 911, and sheriff training uses.
project_scope: Interior renovation of the Washington County Training and Learning Center for the Washington County Emergency Management Agency, Washington County 911, and training space for the Washington County Sheriff's Office.
services: Professional A/E services including interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, and civil engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Existing building interior renovation with no notable structural complexity described.
- Focus is primarily interior design, space planning, and refurbishment rather than structural or bridge engineering.
- No indication of long spans, special structures, innovative materials, or sustainability features.
- Building type is an administrative/training facility, which is generally low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender notice.
